architecture_and_changes_summary.technical_details: Implemented PeSTO tapered piece-square evaluation tables interpolating between middlegame and endgame across a 24-step game phase. Built Negamax Minimax with Alpha-Beta pruning, Quiescence search with delta pruning to eliminate horizon effect, and Zobrist hashing transposition tables. Move predictor evaluates multi-candidate branches and translates centipawns to win probability via logistic sigmoid.
architecture_and_changes_summary.test_coverage: 9 unit tests in tests/test_engine.py verifying mate-in-one, checkmate detection, quiescence, and piece-square tables.

architecture_and_changes_summary.technical_details: Constructed interactive terminal CLI game with ANSI/Unicode side-by-side telemetry. Built Three.js WebGL 2.0 3D platform with turn-sculpted procedural Staunton pieces, parabolic jump animations, explosive capture physics particles, glowing valid-move beacons, and synthesized Web Audio sound generator.
architecture_and_changes_summary.test_coverage: 7 API endpoint integration tests in tests/test_api.py verifying /api/evaluate, /api/move, /api/predict, /api/heatmap, and /api/validate.

architecture_and_changes_summary.technical_details: Diagnosed and eliminated false-positive time cutoff in predictor.py by explicitly resetting search time limits before candidate iteration. Added kid-friendly 'Play Best Move' coach button with celebratory HTML5 canvas confetti particles, friendly speech bubbles, and Level 1 gentle bot difficulty. Packaged portable Cloudflare quick tunnel launcher.
architecture_and_changes_summary.test_coverage: 20 regression test cases in tests/test_regressions.py verifying timeout bounds, promotion variants, and concurrency.

architecture_and_changes_summary.phase: Phase 4 - Motion Graphics, Human Polishing & Live Deployment

architecture_and_changes_summary.test_coverage: 36 test cases passing across all suites with zero failures.

adjust_ai_strength.explanation: Depth 1 is super gentle for young children; Depth 3 is suitable for casual club players; Depth 4-5 is master/grandmaster tournament strength.

customize_piece_materials.explanation: Modify color hex codes, roughness, metalness, or emissive intensities to create custom board and piece themes.

tweak_animation_speed.explanation: Default is 280ms. Set to 180ms for lightning blitz or 450ms for dramatic cinematic moves.

customize_sound_effects.explanation: Modify oscillator frequencies and attack/decay ramps to customize wooden knocks or futuristic electronic sounds.

local_live_global_tunnel.mechanism: Starts FastAPI uvicorn daemon and establishes a secure Cloudflare QUIC HTTPS tunnel generating a live trycloudflare.com URL.

local_lan_wifi.mechanism: Connects across your home or college campus Wi-Fi network at http://<LOCAL_IP>:8000.

terminal_interactive_cli.mechanism: Runs python backend/cli_game.py in modern Windows Terminal or PowerShell.
